title: House Robber
description:
You are planning to rob houses along a street. House `i` holds `nums[i]` dollars, but robbing two **adjacent** houses triggers the alarm.

Return the maximum amount you can rob without robbing two adjacent houses.
hints: For each house you either skip it or rob it plus the best from two houses back.
You only need the previous two results, so O(1) extra space is enough.
